risks: Email/query queryState is not Email/get/Email/changes state; opaque JMAP states cannot be sorted lexicographically or treated like Gmail history numbers.
SSE coalescing/retry does not guarantee catch-up; silently dropping push type/account states currently hides durable ingest requirements.
A paginated rebuild racing provider writes is not a completed snapshot; require provider checkpoint/change catch-up before absence-based deletion.
Cursor transaction and processed inbox must not commit ahead of normalized rows/tombstones/outbox; claim acknowledgement is not processed acknowledgement.
Old worker or async renderer completion can return after reconnect/revoke; generation/lease/policy checks must be repeated at commit/delivery/cache update.
Current bridge identifies local mailbox by record/address and profile hints; neither is authenticated shared principal or unique workspace account identity.
WP-17/WP-18 share three proposed files and all existing entry points; uncoordinated independent creation would introduce a second store/writer or overwrite lead integration.
Both migration proposals are listed but only one carries explicit migration table record; duplicate DDL and fabricated migrator identifiers must be resolved by root, not silently guessed.
Overview API names HandleProviderChange/ResumeBackfill differ from detailed IngestProviderChange/SyncMail; clarify one canonical mapping rather than adding duplicate surfaces.

Full feature DoD introduces notification/mention/agent/routing and writer/runtime gates not represented by WP-18's direct DAG edges. These cannot be deferred to WP-41 or marked N/A solely because absent.

Mandatory webhook authentication is required before downstream Gmail/Microsoft adapters exist; retain fail-closed typed port and obtain actual supported-provider auth evidence rather than enabling optional auth or asserting fixtures are live.

Gmail history, Microsoft delta and IMAP UIDVALIDITY need provider-specific checkpoint/reset identity semantics; do not weaken WP-18 to JMAP-only acceptance or assume downstream live implementations now exist.
Trash move is not message destruction; tombstone semantics must follow normalized provider lifecycle without breaking current local remove/draft/send behavior.
Existing logs can include address or provider description; new trace fields must not leak raw email/body/transcript/tokens or PRIVATE_WP-18 payload.
Inspected bytes may change during wave0 integration. This report is fingerprinted evidence, not an implementation receipt tied to future HEAD.
